frozen_criteria.primary: greedy > |g| at K=64 and K=256 in >=7/8 contexts, exact two-sided sign test, median relative gain > 0
frozen_criteria.secondary: pooled greedy list at K=64 retains >=73% of full-support effect
frozen_criteria.stability: median pairwise Jaccard of the 8 per-context lists at K=64 >= 0.30 (the registered G1 top-64 overlap gate)

retention.note: retention = pooled-greedy mean dJ2 / pooled-greedy at Kmax, per budget
